# AEO Toolkit

> Free, open-source tools that audit and improve how AI assistants see your website. One URL in, complete AI Readiness Score out.

Built by Boxford Partners (https://www.boxfordpartners.com), an AI operations consultancy for service and B2B businesses.

## What This Is

Three Python tools (zero external dependencies for core audit) that measure and improve AI visibility:

- **AEO Pipeline** — Full AI readiness scan. Returns a 0-100 combined score across technical visibility, content quality, and agent readiness. Opens an interactive dashboard.
- **AI Visibility Audit** — Technical scoring across four dimensions: AI crawler access (25pts), structured data (30pts), content citability (25pts), entity/authority (20pts). Includes copy-paste fix recommendations.
- **Content Quality Engine** — Analyzes text against five citability signals: burstiness, vocabulary, hedging, monotony, specificity. Works on files or URLs.

## Quick Start

```
git clone https://github.com/patrickboxfordpartners/rote-playoffs.git
cd rote-playoffs
python3 -m aeo_pipeline yoursite.com
```

## MCP Server

The toolkit includes an MCP server for Claude Desktop and Claude Code integration. Three tools: audit_url, analyze_content, full_pipeline.
